prompt: Japanese cel-shaded anime, bold black outlines, two-step hard shading, high contrast, 16:9 landscape. @Image1 is the swordsman. @Image2 is the woman mage. @Image3 is the teenage boy. @Image4 is the greatsword he carries. @Image5 is the staff she carries. @Image6 is the thick clasped book the boy holds. @Image7 is the temple hall seen from the side. @Image8 is the same hall seen over a shoulder. @Image9 is the stone column corner of that same hall. Every shot keeps these exact designs: the same faces, the same hair, the same armour and robe, the same weapons, and the same hall with the same columns, the same floor and the same moonlight direction. The whole video happens inside one abandoned stone temple at night, tall broken columns along both sides, moonlight falling through a crack in the domed ceiling, loose rubble across the flagstone floor, cool blue moonlight from above as the single light source. The camera stays in motion through the whole video and comes to rest for the last beat. 0–1.5s, the camera tracks low along the floor from left to right, ending on a wide shot holding both of them with the open floor between them, the swordsman stands at the left end of the hall with his blade point resting on the flagstones and his shoulders rising and falling, and broken columns and rubble fill the space between the two of them. 1.5–3s, the camera keeps gliding right and rises a little, ending on a medium shot of the woman at the right end, she lifts her arm so the wide sleeve falls back and shows the silver-grey lining, and her weight settles onto her back foot. 3–4.2s, the camera arcs around her while she moves, ending on a medium shot travelling with her, she steps backwards along the row of columns, and while her feet keep moving her left hand touches thumb to index finger, then to middle finger, then to ring finger. 4.2–5.5s, the camera whips left along the flight path of the bolts, ending on a wide shot of the hall, the silver ring at the top of her staff flares and three blue rhombic bolts leave it one after another, each drawing a short tail across the hall. 5.5–7s, the camera tracks with him at knee height, ending on a medium shot moving with him, he rolls sideways under the first bolt, comes up and turns the flat of the greatsword into the second bolt so sparks burst off the steel, and drops his head under the third bolt, which passes through the hair beside his ear. 7–8.2s, the camera sinks to floor level and races forward with him, ending on a low wide shot, he sinks into a deep knee bend, drags the sword tip back across the stone and pushes off, the tip drawing a line of sparks along the floor as he covers the ground between them. 8.2–9s, the blade sweeps across the lens and its highlight fills the frame, ending on a tight shot on the blade, the sword rises across the camera and the polished edge takes the light. 9–10.2s, the camera cranes up with him and circles a quarter turn, ending on a low angle shot of him at the top of the arc, he leaps and lifts the greatsword overhead with both hands, and at the top of the arc his body holds while his hair and the straps of his chest guard keep drifting. 10.2–11.2s, the camera rushes in to the point where the steel meets the lattice, ending on a tight shot on the contact point, the blade comes down half a step in front of her and she raises the staff horizontally in both hands to take it. 11.2–12s, the camera pulls back out through the burst of light, ending on a medium two shot, the pale blue outer layer of the hexagonal lattice breaks into fine drifting points of light that scatter outward, and two layers remain. 12–13.4s, the camera pulls back along with him, ending on a wide shot with the open floor opening up between them, she pushes the silver ring forward one-handed, the crystal inside it flares, and he is driven backwards with the sword tip dragging a line of sparks across the flagstones for three steps. The man being driven back says in Chinese: 书里最后一页能解我妹妹的咒。 13.4–15s, the camera keeps drifting back and slides sideways past a foreground column, ending on a wide shot of the whole hall, he plants the sword point on the stone and the two of them stand at opposite ends of the floor again. 15–16.5s, a handheld camera drifts unsteadily and creeps closer, ending on a medium close shot of the boy, the boy presses his back flat to a stone column and holds a thick clasped book shut against his chest with both hands, his fingernails digging into the leather cover, and his shoulders jerk once while light from the hall flickers across his face. 16.5–18s, the camera tilts down along with the falling column of light, ending on a low angle wide shot, she plants the staff tip on the flagstones and her knee bends as her weight sinks, and three hexagonal sigils light up on the floor around him one after another. 18–19.6s, the camera whips sideways to travel with him, ending on a medium tracking shot, three columns of light slam down from the ceiling in sequence with stone chips bursting where they land, and he rolls sideways past the first and turns the flat of his blade into the edge of the second. 19.6–21s, the camera keeps travelling with him and swings around to face him, ending on a medium shot, he drives through the gap between the last two columns of light and comes out the far side with sparks trailing off his blade. 21–22.4s, the camera arcs around the pair of them, ending on a medium two shot, he crosses into her reach, crimson spread past his irises across the whites of his eyes, black lines running up to his collarbone and white vapour leaving his mouth as he breathes, and he swings the greatsword one-handed on a flat horizontal path with his waist turning a half circle. 22.4–23.6s, the camera continues around and pushes in, ending on a medium close shot of her, she plants the staff tip and steps back, and the edge of the blade takes a single strand of pale blonde hair from beside her ear, which drifts down. 23.6–25s, the camera keeps circling around them, ending on a medium shot, he brings his left forearm up in front of his face and meets the shaft of her staff with the iron pauldron on that shoulder, turning the shaft aside. 25–26s, the camera drops to floor level and slides in, ending on a low tight shot, he sinks into a knee bend and drives the sword forward flat along the floor, throwing up chips of stone, and she brings the staff down horizontally to take it while the deep blue hexagonal mesh cracks open from the point of contact like glass, and one layer remains. 26–27.4s, the camera cranes up and circles behind him, ending on a low angle medium shot, he lifts the greatsword overhead with both hands while white vapour pours from his mouth, and his body holds at the top of the lift while embers drift upward around him. 27.4–28.6s, the camera rushes in to the contact point, ending on a tight shot on the lattice, the blade comes down and she takes it on the horizontal staff, and a single crack opens across the silver-white inner layer. 28.6–30s, the camera pulls back fast and comes to rest, ending on a wide shot of the hall, the two of them hold against each other at the centre of the hall with that crack held open between them, and the picture settles. The whole thing is one single unbroken take: the camera follows exactly the path described above, in one continuous move, and stays inside that same hall for all 30 seconds. Sound: a long stone hall ringing with echo, loose rubble ticking down somewhere far off, and the scrape of a sword tip dragged over flagstone boots scuffing continuously over grit, three short bright chimes in quick succession, and three sharp bursts as the bolts leave the ring three whistles of air in sequence, a hard clang of steel meeting steel, and a long grinding scrape as a blade tip ploughs across stone a deep impact of metal against crystal, a glassy shatter, and a fine ringing as light grains scatter outward a low pressure wave, boot heels ploughing backwards over stone, and sparks spitting off the floor muffled impacts carrying through stone from further off, and tight shallow breathing close to the microphone three descending roars arriving in sequence, stone chips bursting, and wind rushing past as he moves between them three clashes of steel in quick succession, a light snap as hair parts, grit hissing up ahead of a blade, and a glassy crack spreading through a mesh a low building hum, one heavy collision, and a long ringing tail spreading into the echo of the hall
lines: 书里最后一页能解我妹妹的咒。
